title: Revert "Expose AppService location and EUDB membership on Environment Information for internal consumption (#9716)"
summary: Removed Microsoft-only methods from the public Environment Information codeunit to avoid exposing internal functionality that third-party extensions cannot use.
key_points: Reverted addition of GetApplicationServiceLocation() and IsApplicationServiceInEUDB() methods
These methods were restricted to Microsoft-published callers via NavApp.GetCallerModuleInfo
Removed companion test codeunit for partner testing
Eliminates anti-pattern of public API advertising functionality unavailable to third parties
quote: Exposing Microsoft-only functionality on a public System Application codeunit is an anti-pattern we want to avoid.
